name: Supine Abdominal Bracing
steps: Lie on your back on the floor or a mat with your knees bent at 90 degrees and your feet flat on the floor.
Rest your arms comfortably at your sides and keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Take a normal breath in, then as you exhale, gently tighten your deep abdominal muscles as if bracing for a light punch to the stomach.
Draw your navel slightly inward and flatten your lower back firmly against the floor.
Hold this firm abdominal contraction for 10 to 15 seconds while continuing to breathe shallowly.
Relax your muscles completely, then repeat for the prescribed repetitions.
coaching_cues: Do not hold your breath; practice breathing steadily in and out while keeping your core braced.
Feel your lower back press flat against the floor.
Avoid curling your neck or shoulders off the floor.
